strategies.name: Patriots Coaching Pair
strategies.description: On the same Kalshi 'who coaches Week 1' contract, Stu plays yes on Vrabel (underpriced at 72%, he estimates true probability at 85-90%) and no on Tomlin (overpriced at 10%, Stu says true probability is zero). Together they cover the contract from both ends, collecting the near-certain no on Tomlin while holding a positive-expected-value yes on Vrabel.
